svg.text: SOCIETY STALL LAYOUT · 6 ft TABLE · FRONT VIEW + TOP VIEW
visitors queue at the sides, never in front of the table
Ivory cloth, midnight skirt, brand line
Royal Collection at eye level (4–5 ft)
Peri Peri left, Kadi Patta right, on risers
Two jars: drop a cashew in your favourite
Scan to order / pre-order via WhatsApp
Rule of thumb: hero product at eye level · trial packs at hand level · samples at the front corner · price and QR always visible
